bugLogs.title: Icon-only button lacks accessible name
steps_to_reproduce: Attempt to activate it using keyboard
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Screen reader announces a descriptive name for the button, e.g., 'Show password'
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Button has no visible text, no aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, or label, so screen reader announces nothing or generic 'button'
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add aria-label="Show password" to the button: .eye { aria-label: "Show password" }

bugLogs.title: Low contrast error message text on login page
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the paragraph with class "error" that displays "Incorrect email or password"
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The error message text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The paragraph text color #e8a0a0 on a white background (#ffffff) yields a contrast ratio of 2.1:1, below the required 4.5:1.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for p, change color from #e8a0a0 to #996a6a (4.54:1 on #ffffff; measured 2.1:1, required 4.5:1).

bugLogs.title: Login form fields lack persistent labels
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Each form input must have a visible, persistent label that remains when the field is focused
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Both email and password inputs rely solely on placeholder text and have no <label>, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title attributes
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add <label for="login-email">Email</label> before the email input and <label for="login-password">Password</label> before the password input; alternatively add aria-label="Email" to the email input and aria-label="Password" to the password input
